title: Charging port and USB port placement
summary: Feedback centers on inconvenient charging-port location, awkward USB placement, limited port availability, and a few descriptive or preference-based comments about charging hardware.

negative.summary: Negative feedback focuses on poorly placed charging ports and USB ports, slow charging performance, and too few available ports.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined comments include location preferences, a charge-port door opening issue, observations about charging capability, and both favorable and unfavorable descriptions of USB port placement.

limitations: Many examples are phrased as preferences, observations, or explanations rather than clear satisfaction judgments, which limits sentiment certainty.
This topic mixes charging-port location, USB port placement, port availability, charging speed, and a charge-port door issue rather than a single tightly focused subject.
The sample is small and stratified, so it should not be treated as representative of all owners or vehicles.
